command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
cd /tmp
printf '%s  %s\n' f5be190849cd5f78765db79ba8aaa9f90519847a7cf1594b4be057a8085c8843 run.sh a286a829b876eb37fea9fc665ed5242a62eeb955b59feac398689df18e5b92f2 sesame-real.R 3a4aa6e3b46b676be96eeb320031daab4c12559ec3bdf4f037e6b329613c0d2a pheno.tsv 67af70d7178a5b8a3ac196cd1dc76ee2b5656bc1c2c36b0d9678eefb1a0ccb12 idat.sha256 > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
# the recipe's pinned ExperimentHub cache plus probeIDSignature for inferSex (sesame-cache.sh), checked by content
mkdir -p /tmp/sesamehome
tar -xmf /tmp/sesame-cache.tar -C /tmp/sesamehome --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions
C=/tmp/sesamehome/.cache/R/ExperimentHub
printf '%s\n' 59fb9bcbd5a430fe4cbfe39333c2d716e71480dc03077533299aee764a32fbe3 73578ce17c439acc8e1443f9a6c55c3f02fdcc18cdff287b7b93f74cb86c835e 99300ba1d45aec5d5fdcdb12b61923f7313b1600c4ec9c8b9ca573d09bfc1655 a216599b21bf2aae080922a3ced2b7817e8bdf183255b7c119852266dddf305f b4eb0da4ef492655c2fe18b45fa65e969967c9f4a0c2149a5fae9241b510c7b2 > /tmp/want.txt
( cd "$C" && for x in $(ls | grep -vE 'sqlite|LOCK'); do sha256sum "$x" | cut -d' ' -f1; done ) | sort > /tmp/got.txt
diff /tmp/want.txt /tmp/got.txt || { echo 'FAIL: sesameData cache contents do not match the pins'; exit 1; }
export HOME=/tmp/sesamehome WORKERS=16 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
bash run.sh sesame-real.R
